mutations.name: verify-always-good
mutations.what: any signature is taken for a good one

patches.old: try { good = verify('sha256', manifestBytes, { key: key.publicKey, dsaEncoding: 'ieee-p1363' }, document.sig); } catch { good = false; }
patches.new: try { good = true; } catch { good = false; }

mutations.name: verify-as-der
mutations.what: the signature is read as DER instead of the 64 bytes r||s that the other side makes

mutations.name: sign-as-der
mutations.what: the signature is made in DER form, which the desktop shell does not read

patches.old: const signature = sign('sha256', manifestBytes, { key: privateKey, dsaEncoding: 'ieee-p1363' });
patches.new: const signature = sign('sha256', manifestBytes, { key: privateKey });

mutations.name: any-key-for-any-kid
mutations.what: the first key is tried whatever id the signature names

mutations.name: alg-unchecked
mutations.what: any algorithm name is accepted

mutations.name: kid-shape-unchecked
mutations.what: any text is a key id

mutations.name: signature-length-unchecked

mutations.name: base64-not-canonical
mutations.what: base64 that is not the canonical form of its bytes is accepted

mutations.name: utf8-lenient
mutations.what: a signature file that is not UTF-8 is decoded anyway

mutations.name: signature-size-unchecked
mutations.what: a signature file of any size is read

mutations.name: signature-empty-unchecked
mutations.what: an empty signature file is not named as empty

mutations.name: signature-shape-unchecked
mutations.what: a signature file that is not a JSON object is not named as such

patches.old: if (!document || typeof document !== 'object' || Array.isArray(document)) throw invalid('shape', 'The signature file is not a JSON object.');
patches.new: if (false) throw invalid('shape', 'The signature file is not a JSON object.');

mutations.name: key-curve-unchecked
mutations.what: a key of another curve or type is not named as such

mutations.name: kid-mismatch-accepted
mutations.what: an entry whose id is not the one its key gives is trusted

mutations.name: duplicate-accepted
mutations.what: a key listed twice is trusted twice

mutations.name: fifth-key-accepted
mutations.what: more keys than the file has room for are trusted

mutations.name: placeholder-not-counted

mutations.name: key-id-short

mutations.name: sign-any-private-key
